title: Club Finder
subtitle: Making a powerful shopping tool easier to use increased desktop add-to-cart conversion by 16.20%.

quickView.problem: Categories were easy to miss, filters were hard to understand, and product rows were difficult to scan.
quickView.product: A tested refresh with stronger category selection, clearer filters and states, product imagery, and mobile improvements.
quickView.impact: Validated outcomes include +16.20% desktop add-to-cart conversion and +7.69% desktop order conversion.
